paragraphs.text: Roalesk , the First Guardian , is the first successful result of the Simic Guardian Project .

Roalesk was among the first of Vannifar 's successful experiments under the Guardian Project . He is an incredible fighter and spy, incorporating a variety of adaptations from different species. His body and mind have been heavily altered in the process. Although anyone can see he's an asset to the guild, even among the Simic many hesitate to call him human . Only Vannifar knows the full list of donor species, and none save perhaps Roalesk himself know the limits of his capabilities.
During the War of the Spark , Roalesk fought Nicol Bolas ' forces.
He survived both the war and the New Phyrexian Invasion , as he was seen roaming the skies during the Murders at Karlov Manor
